scope: One bounded story with three tasks and five criteria: reset existing conversations on admitted mode changes for both adapters and delivery configurations, preserve same-mode resume and recovery, point the common prompt to safely resolved existing task artifacts, and add focused offline regressions. feature-spec.md and ARCH_REVIEW.md remain the concrete narrowed plan. Run 0007 replacement preflight was rejected; no completed replacement was submitted.
decisions: Owner requested simpler scope in run 0004 and approved replanning in run 0005. Preserve same-mode resumability, bounded comments, task/worktree/artifacts, approved frozen inputs and existing gates. Cover both adapters and delivery configurations. No new schema, persistent binding subsystem, generalized handoffs, protected-tree rollout or authentic-agent observation gate. Run 0006 asks only for a brief explanation; narrowed scope remains unchanged. Proposed detection compares the admitted next mode with the mode of the last actually used run in the candidate conversation segment; a difference allocates a fresh segment, while the same mode retains eligible resume. Refused or prelaunch attempts do not establish conversation use. Existing external delivery already incorporates mode into conversation identity; the change makes no-external-delivery selection consistent. Run 0007 explicitly authorizes finalizing the narrowed plan and retiring the superseded seven user stories. This settles retirement authority; no further owner permission or product decision is needed. Factory-supported retirement capability must still be established before claiming execution. Run 0008 asks whether the owner must manually close the obsolete stories. Clarification from retained protocol evidence: closing a GitHub issue alone does not remove its indexed factory scope or satisfy the rejected replacement contract. Do not recommend manual closure as a solution to this blocker. Run 0009 requests manual recovery instructions and says a separate long-term fix issue will be filed. Verified supported workaround: abandon the obsolete parent scope by closing #227 and obsolete stories #240–246 as not planned, then create an independent, fully populated replacement parent assigned to the configured owner at creation. Keep historical indexes and acceptance intact; this does not repair or retire the original factory scope. No external actions are performed by this run.
assumptions: Use existing identity-bound Plan session or rooted task artifact discovery across dates. Missing artifacts use ordinary setup; conflicting/unsafe paths must not invent continuity. Repository tests prove selection, invocation and prompt behavior, not model comprehension or live-provider behavior. Operator will wait for this run and factory save to finish before closure, since closure is a future-admission control, not active-run cancellation. For reliable first-body triggering, create replacement already owner-assigned with body beginning /plan followed by instruction, canonical Mode: Plan label, and no initial comments. Never attach obsolete children or replacement as a child of #227.
questions: No product or permission questions. Original parent replacement publication remains blocked on factory-supported indexed-story retirement. A verified manual bypass is a new independent parent, with closure of obsolete issues stopping their future dispatch while preserving historical scope. User will file long-term fix separately. New parent must publish and save its own Plan before /implement; current run establishes no new readiness or external effects.
